name: Isle of Quel’Danas
shortDescription: The northern Eastern Kingdoms isle that hosts the TBC Shattered Sun Offensive and the approach to Sunwell Plateau; it also appears in the later Wrath Quel’Delar quest.
body: In The Burning Crusade, the isle is the objective of the Shattered Sun Offensive. This is separate from the 3.3.5 Quel’Delar restoration story.
